help.faq.cycle-record-period.question: Nandika gute imihango yanje?
help.faq.cycle-record-period.subtitle: Ongeraho amatariki n'igihe imihango imara.
help.faq.cycle-record-period.answer: Mu kalendari canke mu Kayi ya buri munsi, andika igihe imihango itangurira, igihe imara, n'ingene amaraso ari menshi. Aya makuru yubaka amateka yawe bwite kandi niyo agaragaza ibigereranyo biri muri AWA.
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.question: Nshobora guhindura itariki y'imihango?
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.subtitle: Rungika itariki nimba ibikurikirane vyawe vyahindutse.
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.answer: Ego. Hindura itariki ijanye n'ibikurikirane vyawe kugira amateka yawe ahuze n'uruziga rwawe nyarwo. Ibigereranyo birashobora guhinduka hakurikijwe amakuru mashasha wabitse.
help.faq.cycle-predictions.question: Imihango itaha ibarwa gute?
help.faq.cycle-predictions.subtitle: Ibigereranyo bishingiye ku mateka yawe bwite.
help.faq.cycle-predictions.answer: AWA igereranya imihango yawe itaha, iminsi y'uburumbuke na ovulation hakurikijwe amateka yawe bwite, uburebure bw'uruziga rwawe n'amakuru wandika. Ibigereranyo ntibishingira gusa ku ruziga rusanzwe rw'iminsi 28.
help.faq.cycle-flow.question: Nkurikirana gute ingene amaraso y'imihango ari menshi?
help.faq.cycle-flow.subtitle: Andika ingene amaraso ahinduka.
help.faq.cycle-flow.answer: Koresha Ikayi ya buri munsi wandike ingene amaraso y'imihango yawe ari menshi. Ivyo bibika amateka y'ukuntu ahinduka mu ruziga rwawe.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.question: Utwamenyetso two muri kalendari tuvuga iki?
help.faq.cycle-calendar.subtitle: Imihango, uburumbuke, ovulation na kalendari ya Hijri.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.answer: Kalendari yerekana iminsi y'imihango wanditse hamwe n'iminsi y'uburumbuke na ovulation vyagereranijwe. Nimba ibimenyetso vy'iyobokamana vyaguruwe, itariki ya Hijri na yo irashobora kwerekanwa iruhande y'itariki ya Gregorian.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.subtitl: Raba iminsi igereranijwe ko ari yo y'uburumbuke kuruta.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.answer: Muri uburyo bwo Gushaka inda, AWA yerekana iminsi y'uburumbuke yagereranijwe hakurikijwe amakuru y'uruziga rwawe n'amateka yawe bwite.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.question: Ovulation yanje igereranywa gute?
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.subtitle: Igereranya rihinduka uko ukurikirana.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.answer: Ovulation igereranywa hakurikijwe amakuru ari mu mateka y'uruziga rwawe. Iki gereranya gishobora guhinduka uko wongeraho amakuru mashasha.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.question: Nshobora gukurikirana ubushuhe bw'umubiri bw'ibanze?
help.faq.conceive-temperature.subtitle: Ongera ubushuhe bw'umubiri mu bikurikirane vy'uburumbuke.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.answer: Ego. Gukurikirana ubushuhe bw'umubiri bw'ibanze biri mu buryo bwihariye bwo gushaka inda.
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.questio: Nshobora gukurikirana ibisohoka mu nkondo y'inda?
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.subtitl: Ongeraho iki kintu cabonetse mu bikurikirane vy'uburumbuke.
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.answer: Ego. Gukurikirana ibisohoka mu nkondo y'inda ni kimwe mu bimenyetso biboneka muri uburyo bwo Gushaka inda.
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.question: Nshobora kwandika ikizamini ca LH ca ovulation?
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.subtitle: Bika ivyavuye mu bikurikirane vyawe.
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.answer: Ego. Kwandika ibizamini bya LH bya ovulation biri mu rugendo rwo gushaka inda.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.question: Nandika gute imibonano?
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.subtitle: Akantu k'ibanga mu kayi kawe.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.answer: Igice c'Ubuhisho kigufasha kwandika imibonano n'andi makuru bijanye. Iki gice kigumya kuba ibanga kandi gishobora kurindwa ukwacyo.
help.faq.contraception-method.question: Ni uburyo ki bwo kuboneza urubyaro nshobora gukurikirana?
help.faq.contraception-method.subtitle: Ikinini, impeta, patch n'imiti ya hormone.
help.faq.contraception-method.answer: AWA ifasha gukurikirana ikinini co kuboneza urubyaro, impeta yo mu gitsina, patch yo kuboneza urubyaro, n'indi miti ya hormone.
help.faq.contraception-pill-reminder.ans: Ego. AWA itanga ibibutsa wihitiramwo vyo kunywa ikinini cawe, hamwe n'ibimenyeshwa bya buri munsi.
help.faq.contraception-forgotten-pill.an: Ego. Gukurikirana ibinini vyibagiranye biri mu rugendo rwo kuboneza urubyaro.
help.faq.contraception-history.question: Amateka y'ukunywa ndayasanga hehe?
help.faq.contraception-history.subtitle: Raba ibinini wanyoye n'ibyo wibagiwe.
help.faq.contraception-history.answer: Hariho amateka y'ukunywa kugira ubike ibikurikirane vyawe vyo kuboneza urubyaro.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.quest: Ibigereranyo biracafise akamaro igihe nkoresha uburyo bwo kuboneza urubyaro?
help.faq.contraception-predictions.subti: Uburyo bumwebumwe bushobora guhindura uruziga rwawe kamere.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.answe: AWA irashobora gukomeza kwerekana amakuru y'ibikurikirane aboneka, ariko ukuntu usobanura ibigereranyo biterwa n'ibiguhaye n'uburyo ukoresha. Iyi porogarama ntisubira mu cibanza c'inama z'abaganga.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.question: Uruziga rurerure rufatwa nk'ururatinze?
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.subtitle: AWA itekereza ku ruziga rudahoraho.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.answer: Oya. Muri uburyo bwa PCOS/Uruziga rudahoraho, AWA ntifata uruziga rurerure nk'ururatinze.
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.question: Ni ibimenyetso ki nshobora gukurikirana mfise PCOS?
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.subtitle: Raba ibimenyetso bihinduka uko igihe gihita.
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.answer: Gukurikirana birimwo uruziga rudahoraho, ibiheri mu maso, imisatsi ikura, impinduka z'uburemere n'ibindi bimenyetso bijanye.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.question: Nshobora gukurikirana ibiheri n'imisatsi ikura?
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.subtitle: Ongeraho ivyo wabonye mu bikurikirane vya PCOS.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.answer: Ego. Ibiheri n'imisatsi ikura biri mu bikurikirane vyihariye vya PCOS.
help.faq.irregular-weight.question: Nshobora gukurikirana impinduka z'uburemere bwanje?
help.faq.irregular-weight.subtitle: Raba ukuntu uburemere bwawe buhinduka uko igihe gihita.
help.faq.irregular-weight.answer: Ego. Gukurikirana uburemere biriho muri uburyo bwa PCOS/Uruziga rudahoraho.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.question: Kubera iki ibigereranyo vyanje bihinduka cane?
help.faq.irregular-predictions.subtitle: Uruziga rudahoraho rutuma ibigereranyo bitaba vyizigiye.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.answer: Igihe uruziga rudahoraho, ibigereranyo bishobora guhinduka cane mu buryo busanzwe. AWA ikoresha amateka yawe bwite itabanje gufata uruziga rurerure nk'ururatinze.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.question: Ni ibimenyetso ki nshobora gukurikirana?
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.subtitle: Ibikurikirane bihuye n'impinduka z'iki gihe c'ubuzima.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.answer: Gukurikirana birimwo ubushuhe butunguranye (hot flashes), kubira ibyuya nijoro, ingorane z'ibitotsi, umunaniro, impinduka z'umutima n'ukwibagirwa, n'ibindi.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.question: Nshobora kwandika ubushuhe butunguranye (hot flashes)?
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.subtitle: Raba ingene buza uko igihe gihita.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.answer: Ego. Ubushuhe butunguranye ni kimwe mu bimenyetso biboneka muri uburyo bwa Perimenopause/Menopause.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.question: Nshobora gukurikirana ibitotsi n'umunaniro?
help.faq.menopause-sleep.subtitle: Raba ingorane z'ibitotsi n'umunaniro.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.answer: Ego. Ingorane z'ibitotsi, ibyuya vya nijoro n'umunaniro vyose biraboneka muri uru rugendo.
help.faq.menopause-hormonal-treatment.an: Ego. Urashobora gukurikirana imiti ya hormone muri ubu buryo.
help.faq.menopause-labs.question: Nshobora kwandika ivyavuye mu bizamini bya FSH na estradiol?
help.faq.menopause-labs.subtitle: Ongeraho ivyavuye mu bizamini bimwebimwe vyo mu laboratwari.
help.faq.menopause-labs.answer: Ego. Ivyavuye mu bizamini vyo mu laboratwari nka FSH na estradiol birashobora kwandikwa muri ubu buryo.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.question: Itariki yo kubyara ibarwa gute?
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.subtitle: Igereranya ryerekanwa mu bikurikirane vy'inda yawe.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.answer: Gukurikirana inda bibara itariki yawe yo kubyara yagereranijwe hakurikijwe amakuru ari mu bikurikirane vyawe.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.question: Nshobora gukurikirana inda icumweru ku cumweru?
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.subtitle: Raba ukuntu inda yawe itera imbere icumweru ku cumweru.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.answer: Ego. AWA itanga ugukurikirana icumweru ku cumweru kandi yerekana ukuntu inda yawe itera imbere.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.question: Nshobora kwandika ibihe vyanje vyo kubonana n'abaganga?
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.subtitle: Bika ibihe bikuru hamwe.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.answer: Ego. Ibihe vyo kubonana n'abaganga n'ibizamini bikuru biri mu bikurikirane vy'inda.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.question: Nshobora kubona ibibutsa vy'ibizamini vyanje?
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.subtitle: Shiraho ibibutsa bwite.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.answer: Ego. Ibibutsa bwite vy'ibihe vyo kubonana n'abaganga n'ibizamini bikuru biraboneka.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.question: Nshobora gukurikirana iki mu gihe c'inda?
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.subtitle: Ibimenyetso, uburemere, umutima, ibitotsi n'amakuru bwite.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.answer: Gukurikirana inda bishobora kurimwo ibimenyetso wiyumvamwo, uburemere, umutima, ibitotsi n'amakuru yawe bwite y'ubuvuzi.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.question: Nkurikirana gute lochia yanje?
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.subtitle: Raba igihe imara n'ukuntu ivyasohoka bihinduka.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.answer: Gukurikirana inyuma yo kubyara birimwo igihe lochia imara, ukuntu ivyasohoka bihinduka n'ibimenyetso bijanye.
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.subtitl: Raba uruziga rwawe rusubira buhoro buhoro.
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.answer: AWA ikurikirana isubira ry'uruziga rwawe, isubira ry'imihango n'impinduka za hormone inyuma yo kubyara.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.questi: Nshobora gukurikirana konsa na amenorrhea yo konsa?
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.subtit: Bika aya makuru mu rugendo rwawe rw'inyuma yo kubyara.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.answer: Ego. Konsa na amenorrhea y'inyuma yo kubyara biri mu bikurikirane biboneka.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.question: Nshobora gukurikirana iki mu gihe co gukira?
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.subtitle: Umunaniro, ibitotsi, umutima, ububabare no gukira umubiri.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.answer: Gukurikirana kwa buri munsi inyuma yo kubyara birimwo umunaniro, ibitotsi, umutima, ububabare no gukira umubiri, n'ibindi.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.question: AWA ifata gute nifas?
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.subtitle: Akamenyetso k'iyobokamana, gatandukanye n'ugukurikirana kw'ubuvuzi.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.answer: Igihe ibimenyetso vy'iyobokamana vyaguruwe, AWA irashobora gukurikirana igihe amaraso y'inyuma yo kubyara amara no kwerekana akamenyetso ka nifas hakurikijwe ishingiro ry'iyobokamana wahisemwo. Igihe ntarengwa gishobora gutandukana hagati y'amashure y'ubwenge kandi ntigeze kigaragazwa nk'ukuri kumwe kuri bose aho ibitekerezo bitandukanye.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.question: Nkurikirana gute amaraso yanje?
help.faq.loss-bleeding.subtitle: Raba ukuntu ahinduka, utiriwe usubira vuba mu gukurikirana gusanzwe.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.answer: Urugendo rw'Inyuma yo gukoroka inda rukurikirana amaraso n'ukuntu ahinduka, mu kibanza gihuye n'iki gihe.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.question: Nkurikirana gute isubira ry'uruziga rwanje?
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.subtitle: Subira mu bikurikirane vyawe ku muvuduko wawe.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.answer: AWA ikurikirana isubira ry'uruziga rwawe inyuma yo gukoroka inda, ikagufasha gusubira mu mateka yawe buhoro buhoro utagombwa guhita ukurikirana imihango isanzwe.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.question: Ni ibimenyetso ki nshobora kwandika?
help.faq.loss-symptoms.subtitle: Kurikirana ibimenyetso vy'umubiri ushaka kwandika.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.answer: Gukurikirana ibimenyetso vy'umubiri biraboneka muri uru rugendo.
help.faq.loss-notes.question: Nshobora kubika inyandiko zanje bwite?
help.faq.loss-notes.subtitle: Ikibanza cawe bwite mu kayi kawe.
help.faq.loss-notes.answer: Ego. Inyandiko bwite ziraboneka kugira zigusangire muri iki gihe.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.question: Nshobora gusubira mu gushaka inda nyuma?
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.subtitle: Hindura intumbero yawe igihe cose ushaka kugerageza kandi.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.answer: Gufasha gusubira mu kugerageza gusama vyashizwemwo. Guhindura intumbero yawe bikorwa buhoro buhoro kandi buri gihe ni icemezo cawe.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.question: Kalendari ya Hijri ikora gute?
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.subtitle: Yerekana itariki ya Hijri iruhande y'itariki ya Gregorian.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.answer: Igihe ibimenyetso vy'iyobokamana vyaguruwe, AWA irashobora kwerekana itariki ya Hijri iruhande y'itariki ya Gregorian no kwerekana amezi y'agaciro nka Ramadan canke Dhul Hijjah.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.question: Akamenyetso k'ugusukura (purity) kavuga iki?
help.faq.spiritual-purity.subtitle: Akamenyetso k'ibanga kajanye no gusubira mu bikorwa vy'iyobokamana.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.answer: AWA irashobora kwerekana akamenyetso k'ibanga gatandukanya imihango yawe n'igihe c'ugusukura (tuhr) igihe ibimenyetso vy'iyobokamana vyaguruwe.
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.questio: AWA yerekana gute igihe salat isubiriwe?
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.subtitl: Akamenyetso gashingiye ku gihe imihango irangiriye.
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.answer: Nimba ugusukura gusubiye imbere y'uko igihe ca salat kiriho kirangira, iyi porogarama irashobora kwerekana ko iyo salat isubiye kuba ngombwa. Salat zasimbutse mu gihe c'imihango ntizigera zibarwa nka salat zo kwishura.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.question: Gukurikirana iminsi y'isiyamu yo kwishura bikora gute?
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.subtitle: Kubara iminsi yasimbutse kubera imihango.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.answer: AWA irashobora gutanga ikibaro c'iminsi y'isiyamu yasimbutse kubera imihango yawe, cane cane mu gihe ca Ramadan, hamwe n'ikibutsa gitoya inyuma y'ukwezi co gutunganya kuyishura.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.question: Nifas yerekanwa gute?
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.subtitle: Akamenyetso gashobora gutandukana hagati y'amashure y'ubwenge.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.answer: AWA irashobora kwerekana ishingiro ry'iyobokamana wahisemwo ku gihe ntarengwa ca nifas, igaragaza itandukaniro hagati y'amashure aho ibikorwa vyemejwe bibirimwo. Iyi porogarama ntirigera yerekana umubare umwe nk'ukuri kwuzuye.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.question: AWA itanga inama ku bijanye na istihada?
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.subtitle: Ibikorwa vyo kwiga, atari fatwa yihariye.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.answer: AWA irashobora gutanga ibikorwa rusange vyo kwiga kuri istihada n'icyo bisobanura ku bikorwa vy'iyobokamana. Iyi porogarama ntirigera itanga fatwa yihariye, kandi ibikorwa vy'iyobokamana bigenewe kwemezwa n'ubutegetsi buzwi.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.question: Nshobora kwandika iki mu kayi kanje?
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Ibimenyetso, umutima, ubuhisho, ibitotsi n'ibikorwa.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answer: Ikayi ya buri munsi irimwo ibimenyetso vy'umubiri, ukuntu wiyumva mu mutima, ubuhisho, ibitotsi, imyitozo y'umubiri n'inyandiko bwite.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Ibimenyetso, umutima, ibitotsi, ibikorwa, kunywa amazi, amaraso y'imihango n'inyandiko.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answerDa: Ikayi ya buri munsi igufasha gukurikirana ibimenyetso vy'umubiri, umutima, ibitotsi, imyitozo y'umubiri, kunywa amazi, amaraso y'imihango n'inyandiko bwite.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.question: Igice canje c'Ubuhisho gishobora kurindwa?
help.faq.journal-intimacy.subtitle: Igice c'ibanga, cihariye.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.answer: Ego. Igice c'Ubuhisho gishobora guhishwa no kurindwa na PIN canke Face ID yacyo yihariye.
